bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDY has six issuer-native liability surfaces on Ethereum, Plume, Sui, Aptos, Stellar, and Noble. Arbitrum, Mantle, Sei, BNB Chain, and Tempo are LayerZero burn/mint representations sourced from Ethereum; Solana is also a LayerZero bridge representation, with a 1-of-2 SPL mint multisig whose plain system-owned co-signer retains a token-level mint bypass that remains scoreable here. Osmosis, Mantra, and Injective are Noble-sourced IBC vouchers with reviewed escrow matches. DefiLlama also reports trace Penumbra and Glue labels (~$500 combined) that have no canonical chain mapping and remain an accepted bounded pool.

routes.reviewNote: Canonical USDY home deployment: the 4-of-7 Ondo Safe 0x1a694a09494e214a3be3652e4b343b7b81a73ad7 is the sole DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder and one of four MINTER_ROLE holders. The legacy USDYManager and InstantManager are separate native issuer workflows. The Ethereum LayerZero adapter and its peer, DVN, rate-limit, pause, and owner controls are reviewed separately in bridgeRouteRisk.controls[0].

Verified on-chain 2026-07-20: EIP-1967 proxy (impl 0x5692349f8e7081e2ad0ba629e01761b43187304c) with AccessControl DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE count 1 and MINTER_ROLE count 2. Admin = Ondo 4/7 Safe 0xc4ac5c2fa461901b4d91832d03a7018092edcb4d (Safe getThreshold=4, 7 owners). Minters = that Safe plus Ondo's LayerZero OApp 0x0be393dc46248e4285dc5caca3084bc7e9bfbb41, whose endpoint() returns LayerZero EndpointV2 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fe728c and token() returns the USDY proxy; the OApp is owned by the same Safe. Cross-chain mint therefore requires LayerZero DVN verification plus Ondo Safe governance.

routes.reviewNote: Bridge representation verified at Solana slot 439719046: the SPL mint authority is 1-of-2 multisig 8n2uiRUd1A9NN78PKESkJe6k6zMqtKCZh3MrK1j9qkB1 with signers 7YNReenG6AXgVUfmSizt6hoVXrznS4zDdgCj1UTLJ2S3 (Ondo's documented Solana OFT adapter) and BB7W8gZouRNRGyr8Djx8zyoRcgckrDXkKiMjNMtPwaAQ (plain System-owned key). LayerZero route validation is represented by the first signer, while BB7 retains a token-level mint bypass outside the LayerZero route; both authorities are reviewed in bridgeRouteRisk.controls[1].

Verified on-chain 2026-07-20: first-class Sui coin (suix_getCoinMetadata returns Ondo US Dollar Yield, decimals 6, metadata object 0x81b008387aa52c1a18d3db8e51d1d78d31dbea6295b3cabddbe1fa3c5c00e9c4) published from package 0x960b531667636f39e85867775f52f6b1f220a058c4de786905bdf761e06a56bb; this is a native Sui issuance, not a bridge voucher. The TreasuryCap holder is not enumerable via public Sui RPC in this pass, so the chain-local mint operator identity is asserted from Ondo's documented issuer role rather than an on-chain read.

Verified on-chain 2026-07-20 (Aptos fullnode resources): legacy coin 0xcfea864b...::usdy::USDY whose mint/burn/freeze capabilities (managed_coin::Capabilities) are held by the deployment account itself, an Aptos 0x1::multisig_account requiring 4 of 7 owners (owners enumerated on-chain). Native issuer-minted deployment, not a bridge voucher.

Verified on-chain 2026-07-20 (Horizon): Stellar asset USDY issued by GAJMPX5NBOG6TQFPQGRABJEEB2YE7RFRLUKJDZAZGAD5GFX4J7TADAZ6; the issuer account has low/med/high thresholds 0/0/0 and a single ed25519 master signer of weight 1, i.e. an Ondo-operated single-signer issuance account. Native Stellar issuance, not a bridge voucher.

Noble is USDY's native IBC distribution chain: ausdy is the base denom (cosmos chain-registry Noble assetlist) with a live supply of 13,202,477.20682 ausdy (Noble LCD by_denom, 2026-07-20). All Cosmos USDY vouchers trace back to this Noble-native issuance.

IBC voucher path verified 2026-07-20: Osmosis LCD denom trace resolves ibc/23104D41... to transfer/channel-750/ausdy, the ACTIVE preferred Noble channel-1 to Osmosis channel-750 ics20-1 channel. The controller is the Noble-side ICS-20 escrow noble1kq2rzz6fq2q7fsu75a9g7cpzjeanmk68qxshr6 (Noble escrow_address query for transfer/channel-1), which held exactly 6,135,224,374,098,694,966,821,693 ausdy, matching the Osmosis voucher supply 1:1 at query time.

controls.label: USDY Ethereum LayerZero OFT adapter owner Safe

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: LayerZero OFT burn/mint route; no independent lockbox was identified. Ethereum native mint is distinct from bridge return mint.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: The non-proxy adapter 0xa6275720b3fb1efe3e6ef2b5bf2293148852307d had six owner-configured peers at EIDs 30102, 30110, 30168, 30181, 30280, and 30370; this owner can replace them. Authored routeRefs cover the Ethereum, Arbitrum, Mantle, Sei, Solana, BNB Chain, and Tempo paths.
routeChecks.attestorQuorum: Ondo bridge documentation names Canary DVN, LayerZero Labs DVN, and Ondo DVN; EndpointV2 and DVN verification are route machinery.
routeChecks.rateLimits: At the 2026-08-08 observation, inbound limits were 500,000 USDY for EIDs 30110, 30181, and 30280; 300,000 for EID 30168; and disabled for EIDs 30102 and 30370. The owner can replace these limits.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The adapter was non-proxy and paused=false; its owner was the 4-of-7 Safe, which can pause/unpause, replace peers, and replace rate-limit configuration. Endpoint was 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fe728c and token was Ethereum USDY.

controls.capDescription: Bridge route limits are replaceable by the adapter owner; they do not constrain Ethereum native issuance.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25711915, the USDY LayerZero OFT adapter was non-proxy, paused=false, and owned by the 4-of-7 Safe. Its endpoint, Ethereum USDY token, six peers, DVN-backed message path, and observed inbound per-EID limits are bridge controls. The Safe can replace peers and limits and pause/unpause the adapter; these facts are deliberately scored here rather than in native Mint Authority.

controls.evidence: At Solana slot 439719046, the USDY SPL mint authority was 1-of-2 multisig 8n2uiRUd1A9NN78PKESkJe6k6zMqtKCZh3MrK1j9qkB1 with signers 7YNReenG6AXgVUfmSizt6hoVXrznS4zDdgCj1UTLJ2S3 and BB7W8gZouRNRGyr8Djx8zyoRcgckrDXkKiMjNMtPwaAQ.
